# W=1 and sparse warnings that CI accepts.
#
# Empty since Phase 2: every warning fails the "Extra warnings and sparse"
# CI step. Add an entry only for a warning that cannot be fixed yet, with
# a comment saying why.
#
# One POSIX extended regex per line, matched against the warning line with
# the checkout directory stripped. Wildcard line/column numbers
# ([0-9]+:[0-9]+) so unrelated edits do not invalidate an entry.
